info.name: Efí (formerly Gerencianet) Payments Authorization Open Finance API

items.docs: Lists the banks and fintechs available as payment sources in Brazil's Open Finance ecosystem. Modeled from Efí's documented Open Finance scopes (gn.opb.participants.read); path shown is representative. Scope gn.opb.participants.read.
